critical_code_review_comments: routes_order.check() uses a shared regex ^[\w:.\-]{1,200}$ — slashes are rejected by regex, but FastAPI's path converter also 404s on slashes before validation runs, so clients that produce slash-containing keys get 404 (not the semantic 400). Consider documenting the allowed charset or using a path converter that permits ':' only. Minor UX nit.
routes_order.put_order has no size cap on individual id string length (only list length). Could be hardened by Field(min_length/max_length) on list items.

FolderUploadStatus / folderUpload.js: the status element unmounts as soon as summary appears — summary and skipped are visible but the status with 'X de N' progress disappears before the user can read final counts (acceptable, just noting).
Favoritos/Chuletas pages do not render the SortSelect when list is empty — intentional, but may surprise users; low priority.
